Union accounts: GET /admin/v1/union-accounts (unpaged; auth_status, auth_expires_estimated, reauth_mode, alert_phones_configured; no credential, no alert_stage); POST …/{union_account_id}/reauthorize opens an admin OAuth session (union.account_auth plus totp step-up), GET …/reauthorize/{session_id} polls it; the union redirects to the console page /unions/oauth-callback, which posts state and code (or error) with the admin token to POST /admin/v1/union-accounts/oauth/callback and gets the session result (no unauthenticated endpoint; D10-176 ①); a reauth_mode=manual account on the OAuth start is 20001 [union_account_id] with data.reason=manual_mode, none is 20001 without reason (D10-176 ④); PUT …/{union_account_id}/credential takes a hand-entered credential for manual accounts (kept by ruling D10-196; step-up; plaintext only encrypted into union_credentials, never logged, audited or returned; without expires_at the expiry is estimated from the platform's Key validity in the platform registry, not a fixed 90 days). Alert phones: GET / POST /admin/v1/union-accounts/alert-phones and DELETE …/alert-phones?phone_id=&expected_version= (D10-176 ②), masked numbers only, version conflicts 20902 config_item (D10-176 ③).
